findings.evidence: share() captures an option and awaits shareSummary(), then unconditionally writes shareStatus/manualSummary at lines 141–149. edited() clears those fields but does not invalidate pending share operations. Reproduction: delay clipboard.writeText, click Share, edit the balance so results disappear, then reject the clipboard promise. The pending handler restores the previous option's selectable summary despite the changed inputs. Existing E2E tests await completed sharing before editing, so they miss this ordering. This is a static control-flow finding; runtime reproduction was blocked.
missingTests: Deferred share/clipboard completion after a form edit must not restore an obsolete summary or success status.
